Independent Laboratory Testing & Certificates of Analysis

Every latest Atlas Longevity batch is independently tested by Janoshik and Freedom Diagnostics issued in our company name for complete transparency.

At Atlas Longevity, quality and transparency are at the heart of everything we do.

 

Many of our products are supported by independent laboratory testing and Certificates of Analysis (COAs), helping verify identity, purity and quality.

 

We believe customers should have confidence in the products they purchase, which is why we continue to expand our library of laboratory documentation as new production batches become available.

Our Commitment to Quality

Premium Products Backed by Quality Control

Every product supplied by Atlas Longevity is sourced with quality as a priority.

 

Where available, we provide Certificates of Analysis (COAs) supplied by independent laboratories to demonstrate testing completed on individual production batches.

 

These reports help confirm product identity and quality before products reach our customers.

 

While testing methods and report formats may vary between laboratories, every available document is reviewed before being added to our library.

Understanding Your COA

What Information Does a Certificate of Analysis Include?

Laboratory reports may vary slightly depending on the testing laboratory and analytical methods used.

Most Certificates of Analysis include information such as:

Identity

Confirms the tested material matches the product being analysed.

Purity

Reports the percentage purity determined by laboratory testing.

Batch Number

Links the certificate to a specific production batch.

Analytical Method

May include methods such as HPLC or other recognised analytical techniques where applicable.

Date Tested

Shows when laboratory testing was completed.

Laboratory Information

Details of the laboratory responsible for the analysis.

Why COAs Matter

Why Laboratory Testing Is Important

Laboratory testing helps provide greater transparency regarding individual production batches.

Certificates of Analysis are widely used throughout research and laboratory industries as part of broader quality assurance processes.
